name: Pagaria Energy Limited
about: Pagaria Energy Limited engages in trading of coal in India. The company offers steam coal, petroleum coal, char, and charcoal used as a fuel and coke, as well as for gasification, liquefaction, and industrial and cultural use. It also provides coal consultancy and transportation services. The company was formerly known as Women Networks Limited and changed its name to Pagaria Energy Limited in July 2010. Pagaria Energy Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Kolkata, India.
